q.en: How can I contact the clinic?

a.id: Tautan WhatsApp yang diterbitkan klinik menggunakan 6287772610637. Informasi berasal dari posting 2021.
a.en: The clinic publishes a WhatsApp link using 6287772610637. Confirm current availability.

a.en: Ruko Bumi Mas Kencana Kav O Antapani, Jl. AH. Nasution 928, Kota Bandung 40291. Confirm directions before travelling.

q.en: What should I prepare before visiting?

a.id: Posting poli gigi meminta menghubungi minimal H-1. Konfirmasikan aturan dan jadwal terbaru.
a.en: The dental contact post asks patients to contact the clinic at least one day ahead. Confirm current arrangements.

a.en: Current fees have not been verified. Ask the clinic for a cost breakdown before treatment.
